entries.name: Blorb
entries.description: A small ball of caustic slime with legs slowly paces about.
entries.naturalHistory: These small creatures eat refuse and feces from larger animals. Their slime helps to break it down, and though they're known to be hostile, they aren't known to be particularly dangerous.

mechanics.name: Slime Immunity
mechanics.text: Moves freely through slime.

sources.text: May appear in roaming groups.
Found in special locations in these regions: Dungeon, Cave, Meadow, Forest, Archipelago, Mountain.

entries.name: Giant Rat
entries.description: A huge vermin, the size of a cat, with large yellow incisors.
entries.naturalHistory: An ordinary rat, but grown fat on magickal blood. The essence of gods forces them to spring up faster.

sources.text: May appear in roaming groups.

entries.name: Shellback Beetle
entries.description: A huge, dog sized beetle with a hard, black shell prods its antenna at the ground.
entries.naturalHistory: A huge beetle, most notable for its near impenetrable shell, and slow, lumbering pace. It eats foliage in the shallowest depths of the Flesh.

sources.text: May appear in roaming groups.
Found in special locations in these regions: Dungeon, Cave, Meadow, Forest, Archipelago, Mountain.

entries.name: Hemogoblin
entries.description: A goblin made of blood.
entries.naturalHistory: Ordinary goblins, corrupted by the Flesh. Their skin has melted away, leaving only blood which they track across the floor.

sources.text: May appear in roaming groups.
Found in special locations in these regions: Dungeon, Cave, Meadow, Forest, Archipelago, Mountain.

entries.name: Cave Bat
entries.description: A small bat flits through the air.
entries.naturalHistory: Small flying mammals which populate the high-caves of the Flesh. They suckle from bleeding walls, and from dead creatures.

sources.text: May appear in roaming groups.
Found in special locations in these regions: Dungeon, Cave, Meadow, Forest, Archipelago, Mountain.

entries.name: Pale Jackal
entries.description: A small bipedal creature with pale, near translucent skin and sharp teeth.
entries.naturalHistory: The only pale which can die of age. They are birthed as a defense mechanism of other pales, but within 10 years are often driven irrational by death psychosis.

mechanics.name: Pale Gas Immunity
mechanics.text: Immune to caustic gas, hallucinogenic gas, and Death Gas.

sources.text: May appear in roaming groups.
Can be born from Pale Birther when it has enough Energy.

entries.name: Needleling
entries.description: A dog sized creature with a large needle for a nose. It drips with a green liquid.
entries.naturalHistory: Creatures created by the spawn of Kative to spread disease. Despite their appearance, they are almost purely mechanical, their biological components being just a facade, with the exception of their heart.

mechanics.name: Weak Venom
mechanics.text: On hit: +1 damage per turn from Envenomed. Stacks and refreshes all venom to 5 turns.

sources.text: May appear in roaming groups.
Found in special locations in these regions: Dungeon, Cave, Meadow, Forest, Archipelago, Mountain.

entries.name: Corpse Fungus
entries.description: A large, stationary fungus which emits clouds of toxic gas.
entries.naturalHistory: A common fungus in the Flesh. It spreads roots to corpses, which are in no short supply. Though death has perished, a Corpse Fungus's roots can still paralyze a corpse, until the roots are slashed or burned away.

mechanics.name: Fungal gas
mechanics.text: Emits gas and feeds on visible nearby corpses through roots, preventing their revival while connected.

mechanics.name: Gas Immunity
mechanics.text: Immune to gas and gas explosions.

mechanics.name: Final Death
mechanics.text: Dies permanently; its corpse can feed other fungi.

mechanics.name: Breaking free
mechanics.text: Escaping or burning a root permanently severs its corpse link.

sources.text: Found in special locations in these regions: Dungeon, Cave, Meadow, Forest, Archipelago, Mountain.

entries.name: Short-legged Saidribee
entries.description: A cat-sized bee hovers in the air, stinger prepared.

sources.text: May appear in roaming groups.

entries.naturalHistory: The floating worker of a Saidribee colony. They pollinate and hunt throughout the Flesh, to bring down to their hive queen deeper underneath.

entries.name: Pale Chomper
entries.description: A human-sized biped with pale, near translucent skin and a powerful jaw for a head.

entries.naturalHistory: The most aggressive of the ancient pales. Despite their large mouths, pales do not starve, and are known to survive centuries without food, water or oxygen.

entries.name: Dryad
entries.description: An ordinarily peaceful creature, the Flesh has twisted its mind into assisting it.
entries.naturalHistory: Descended from the God-Trees, these creatures serve to heal and assist those creatures native to the Flesh, and are hostile to those outside.

mechanics.name: Healing Grove
mechanics.text: Can heal an injured ally within sight.

sources.text: May appear in roaming groups.

entries.name: Hemogoblin Bloodmancer
entries.naturalHistory: A goblin magus, rendered of its flesh. Having been born of Hemogoblins in the Flesh, this creature was born with magickal abilities.

mechanics.name: Bloodmancy
mechanics.text: Alternates pulling prey 1 tile and inflicting Hemophilia (20 turns). 7-tile clear shot · 3-turn cooldown, then recovery.

sources.text: May appear in roaming groups.
